# NIST MBE PMI STEP files notice

Source: <https://www.nist.gov/ctl/smart-connected-systems-division/smart-connected-manufacturing-systems-group/mbe-pmi-0#disclaimers>

NIST states that these test cases, CAD models, and STEP files may be used
without restriction. NIST appreciates acknowledgement, but use does not imply
NIST endorsement. The NIST logo must not be used in promotional material.

MADI does not redistribute the archive. The fixture tool downloads the official
source into an ignored local cache and verifies its pinned SHA-256 digest.
